title: Amlak Man: a Persian voice/LLM-assisted real-estate listing manager with a reproducible evaluation harness
description: Multi-tenant PHP/MySQL web application for Persian real-estate agencies with a voice-to-structured-listing pipeline (Whisper-large-v3 transcription, LLM field extraction constrained to a 26-field allow-list) and an academic evaluation harness (word-level Levenshtein WER, field-level micro P/R/F1 with predeclared scoring rules and a 50-case Persian gold set). B.Sc. thesis software artefact.
access_conditions: Source code is proprietary (see LICENSE). Access may be granted to academic reviewers on request.
notes: The repository LICENSE is proprietary. If you want an OPEN record (recommended for a CV / Zenodo badge), switch the repository to MIT or Apache-2.0 first, then set access_right to open and license to MIT.
